name: held-out sample, stage C
seed_note: fixed 14 Nov 2026 before any draw; differs from the development draws (set a seed 7, set b seed 11)

window.reason: already closed when the recipe was fixed (14 Nov 2026), so the sample can be drawn now; starts the day after the latest publication date among the 144 works of set b's 150-work sample that passed the arXiv-id, exclusion and abstract checks (2026-11-03), so no development paper or scanned candidate falls in it; after Haiku 5.5's June 2026 cutoff

draw_note: six days after the window closes, for OpenAlex to index the papers' reference lists (set b, drawn in the week after its window, included papers posted up to six days before the draw); and only once launch.py decide has recorded the stage A decision, stage B is complete (or the group's decision to go on is recorded) and the version-2 predictions are recorded
selection: scan the 150 sampled works in the order OpenAlex returns them
skip a work with no arXiv id in its DOI or ids, or whose arXiv id is excluded
skip a work whose abstract is under 300 characters
take it if its primary topic has fewer than 3 papers taken
replacement: A paper whose PDF cannot be read (over 24 MB, or withdrawn on arXiv) is replaced before any run (launch.py pauses C1 after the draw for this check) by the next eligible work in the same scan (same filters and topic limit), and the swap is recorded in papers_heldout_swaps.json. No other replacement: a paper with no public benchmark is read, counted and not scored.
shortfall: If fewer than 30 are taken from the 150, the sample is what was taken; no second draw and no other seed.
records: sample_raw_heldout.json (every scanned work that passed the arXiv-id, exclusion and abstract checks, in order)
draw_response_heldout.json (OpenAlex's full response to the draw; launch.py records its sha256 in out/launch_2026-11-14/)
reproducibility: OpenAlex's seeded sample is reproducible only while the indexed set is unchanged, so the saved draw response and its hash are the record of the sample.
